row.evidence: Builder.io's pricing page lists Single Sign-On (SSO) only on Enterprise (Custom, Contact sales), and its SSO, user-management and Admin API docs describe SAML/OIDC sign-in, email invitations and AD-group role mapping but no SCIM provisioning.
row.notes: New row. Researched the Builder Code (Visual IDE) pricing tab, which loads by default; the Content (Visual CMS) tab was not compared. Prices shown with the Annual toggle selected (default): Pro $24 and Team $40 per user/mo (Monthly: $30 and $50). Pro allows up to 5 users, so it is the team plan. SAML/OIDC SSO (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace, any IdP) is Enterprise-only. No SCIM is documented: users are invited by email into the Organization and Spaces; an optional, support-enabled feature maps AD groups named builder-{SPACE_ID|ORG_ID}-{ROLE} to roles at SSO sign-in, adding roles but never removing them. The GraphQL Admin API (private key) can list Space users but documents no create/remove-user operations.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented anywhere in the 385-page docs sitemap; false by absence.

auth.notes: Private API key sent as a Bearer token.

capabilities.notes: Only a users query (id, name, email, role, lastActive) is documented; no user mutations are listed among Admin API operations.

limitations.text: Admin API is read-only for users: it lists users but documents no create, update or remove operations.

okta.notes: Builder's guide uses a custom OIDC or SAML app integration; no OIN listing found at okta.com/integrations/builder-io or /builderio.

entra.notes: Builder's Entra guide uses a non-gallery SAML app; no Microsoft Learn tutorial found.

fallbacks.other_sync: AD group to role mapping at SSO sign-in (builder-{SPACE_ID|ORG_ID}-{ROLE_NAME} groups; feature flag enabled by Builder support)
